name: green-dms
description: سامانه جامع فروش و پخش مویرگی (DMS) — monorepo بر اساس dms-design-report.md

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w packages/api-client
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w packages/contracts && npm run typecheck -w packages/api-client && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
